info.description: 줍(Zoop) 프로토타입 BFF. InvestMate PoC의 승인 이슈(inspect())를 요구사항명세서 v0.2 §8 경로로 제공한다. 사용자에게 보이는 그래프는 활성 게시 버전과 관리자 검수 기록이다(`/api/admin/*`은 관리자 전용). 문서 요약·기업별 판정은 S1 worker의 인용·별도 의미 검증과 앱 수입을 마친 저장값만 제공한다. 기업·시장 요약은 `unavailable`이며 회차 판정은 기존 불변 저장값만 읽는다. 일반 GET은 모델을 호출하지 않는다. 시세는 설정한 공급자(토스증권 Open API 또는 무키 공개 출처)의 값을 출처·기준 시각과 함께 주고 없으면 사유와 함께 `unavailable`, 인증·계좌·관심종목·AI 예시 답변은 BFF mock이며 `metadata`로 출처를 표시한다.

put.description:
FS027 single toggle from the sidebar or a company node: the press itself is the save request.

Sends the wanted final state (``watched``) instead of the settings ``version``: a resent or concurrent
toggle is idempotent (no duplicate entry, no 409 to reload), and a toggle never overwrites another
company's change made elsewhere. Members only (guest 403). Adding an unknown company is 404; taking out
a company that is not watched changes nothing. Holdings are separate, so a held company stays a holding
node in the personal graph after it leaves the watchlist. No limit on the number of companies.

get.description:
Approved issues, newest event first.

``from``/``to`` are a KST date (whole day) or date-time; the detail screen sends the same range as its price
chart, ending at the query time (FS040), so an event scheduled after ``to`` is not listed. With a range
(D05): an issue whose event day is known matches by that day (a day without a time stays on that day,
shown as time unknown); an issue whose event day is unknown (no time, or only a month or year) never matches
by its event time and is listed apart in ``unknownTimeItems`` when its latest article publication
(``reportedAt``) falls in the range. The publication time only decides the range; it never becomes the
event time.

get.description:
A published commute-briefing round (07:40 morning / 18:10 evening KST), the same for everyone.

At most three key issues chosen by rule from the round's data window; the round is never padded.
``marketVariables`` holds KOSPI, KOSDAQ and USD/KRW as they stood when the round was generated (value, change
against the previous trading day, the real observation time, source, and a per-indicator state); they are
stored with the published round and never change. An evening round also carries ``sinceMorning``.
A round that is not ready, failed, suspended or corrected says so in ``status``/``notice``/
``corrections`` instead of an error. No prediction, probability or good/bad-news field exists.

parameters.name: date

schema.description: Publication date (KST). Default: the latest round
schema.title: Date

get.description:
What the round's relationship graph is anchored to, and whether it can be shown (FS032).

``available``: the round was published and its publication-time graph can be rebuilt; read it with
``round=<id>`` on ``/api/graph``, ``/api/graph/edges/{id}``, ``/api/events/{id}``, ``/api/evidence/{id}``
and ``/api/companies/{id}``. Later reviews, rule switches and graph versions never change it.
``suspended`` / ``not_published`` / ``unavailable`` (the version or its evidence is gone): a notice, no graph;
the newest graph is never shown in its place. An unknown round id is a 404.

IngestBaseline.title: IngestBaseline
IngestBaseline.description:
The checkpoint the next article-processing run starts from: the start time of the latest run that
finished normally, also when it found nothing new. Failed and cancelled runs never move it.
``unresolved_failures`` counts article files whose latest run failed or was cancelled.

IngestOutcome.title: IngestOutcome
IngestOutcome.description:
What one ``ingest-run`` established (FS058). ``outcome`` is None while the run is queued or running.
``collected``: new articles were processed. ``empty``: the run finished normally and found nothing new
(a success, not a failure). ``failed``/``cancelled``: nothing is confirmed, so no count is recorded
and the baseline stays where it was.

``ok`` and ``delayed`` carry a value (``delayed`` = the newest value the source had is older than the round expects),
``unavailable`` = the source answered but has no value for this point in time (or is not connected),
``failed`` = the request itself failed (network, rate limit, unknown format).
